I wanted to give this plain front yard a premium upgrade, so I grabbed my tools and got to work! Watching the real progress unfold in this timelapse is incredibly satisfying. Here is a step-by-step breakdown of how I built this modern rock garden: 1️⃣ First, I mapped out a smooth, curved border on the grass using white spray paint. 2️⃣ Next, I dug out the edge along the line and laid down a heavy-duty black weed barrier. 3️⃣ I installed a sleek stone border, block by block, to keep everything neat and contained. 4️⃣ Then came the best part—pouring and leveling tons of crisp white river rocks for that beautiful, high-contrast look. 5️⃣ Finally, I styled the space by placing a dark statement sphere, planting some architectural agaves, and adding solar pathway lights. Seeing the before and after of this build progress makes all the hard work totally worth it! Sweet Peet mulch is a premium, all-natural mulch made from composted organic materials, and it offers a range of benefits for both plant health and overall landscape quality. Unlike traditional wood mulches, it’s rich in nutrients, which means it not only protects your soil but actively improves it over time. As it breaks down, Sweet Peet enhances soil structure, promotes beneficial microbial activity, and helps retain moisture—reducing the need for frequent watering. Its dark, uniform color gives beds a clean, high-end appearance while also helping to suppress weeds naturally. Because it’s finely processed, it spreads easily and won’t wash away as quickly in heavy rain, making it a reliable and long-lasting option for maintaining a polished, healthy landscape.#connecticut #greenwich #landscaping #spring #mulch
